name: Creavi Appointment Booking Calendar
author: Creavi

sections.description:
Creavi Appointment Booking Calendar is a clean, beautiful, and scalable appointment booking plugin for WordPress. It is simple to launch, easy to integrate, and free to use without plugin-imposed service or booking limits.

Create bookable services, define availability, collect the details you need, and let customers schedule through a polished calendar flow. The modern service editor combines clear settings with a live preview, so every step is easy to understand and customize.

Connect Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar for free to create events and block busy times. Offer in-person appointments, phone calls, custom meeting links, or free video meetings generated by the plugin. Confirmation emails, reminders, calendar files, timezone handling, and booking buffers are included.

Add Creavi anywhere with shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, Elementor, or another page builder. Use an inline calendar or a styled popup button, and scale from one service to as many services and bookings as your WordPress hosting can support—without a monthly booking-software fee.

Easy Setup – Ready in 2 Minutes
Watch how it works in action:

Check out the live demo: https://wordpress.creavi.dk/booking/
We’re open to any suggestions! Feel free to reach out via the support forum — we’re happy to hear your ideas and may implement them in future updates.

Free Features Included

Creavi provides a complete, user-friendly booking setup for free, including calendar connections, automated reminders, flexible forms, video meetings, exports, and ready-made Gutenberg layouts.

  • Add booking button anywhere via shortcode: [creavibc_booking_button id="123"] (opens booking popup)
  • Embed full booking interface directly on page via shortcode: [creavibc_booking_inline id="123"]

  • Support multiple booking widgets on the same page (different services)

  • Smooth booking experience:

    • Popup or inline layout
    • Step-by-step flow: Date → Time → Details
    • Clean, customizable calendar design with a live admin preview
    • Optional start-time-only summaries and confirmation emails
    • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly

  • Flexible availability settings:

    • Admin-defined available days via date picker
    • Rolling availability range (e.g. next 30–365 days)
    • Exclude specific dates (days off, holidays)
    • Minimum booking notice before an appointment can start
    • Optional 5–60 minute buffer between appointments and connected calendar events
    • Live admin availability grid that updates when the appointment duration or buffer changes

  • Flexible weekday-based time slots:

    • Visual grid selector (e.g. Mon 9:00, Tue 10:30)
    • Different time slots per weekday
    • Optional slot duration: 10 / 15 / 20 / 30 / 60 minutes
    • Dynamic time slots based on selected date

  • Smart timezone handling:

    • Admin timezone detection
    • Timezone modes:
    • Localized (auto-adjust to user timezone)
    • Locked (fixed business timezone)
    • Clear timezone indication on frontend

  • Customizable booking form fields:

    • Editable Name, Email, and Phone default fields
    • Include or hide each default field and choose whether it is required
    • Add custom Text, Textarea, Telephone, and Number fields
    • Edit consent text and privacy-policy links
    • Add as many custom fields as needed

  • Automated email notifications & reminders:

    • Sent to both admin and customer
    • Safe visual HTML editor with media support and plain-text fallback
    • Dynamic tags: {name}, {email}, {phone}, {date}, {time}, {service}
    • Optional reminder emails before the appointment (reduce no-shows)

  • Google Calendar integration:

    • Automatically push bookings to Google Calendar
    • Block already booked time slots from Google Calendar
    • Google Calendar link generation for attendees
    • Custom Google event title and description templates

  • Outlook Calendar integration:

    • Automatically push bookings to Outlook Calendar
    • Per-service Outlook connection and sync
    • Block busy Outlook time slots on the frontend
    • Custom Outlook event title and description templates

  • Calendar & scheduling:

    • Downloadable .ics (iCalendar) file
    • Per-service calendar language and localized date summaries
    • 67 explicit language and regional calendar choices, plus the website default
    • Automatic cleanup of completed booking records after a preset or custom retention period
    • Choose whether eligible records move to Trash or are deleted permanently

  • Booking management and exports:

    • Select bookings in All Bookings and export them to CSV or Excel
    • Exported columns include customer, service, date, time, meeting, and custom-field data
    • CSV files are ready to open or import into Google Sheets

  • Meeting & location options:

    • In-person meetings
    • Online meetings (video or custom link)
    • Phone call option

  • Built-in video conferencing:

    • Free automatic meeting link generation

  • Personalization options:

    • Custom brand color
    • Personalized thank-you message

  • Clear booking management with no plugin-imposed service or booking limits

  • Beautiful, aligned admin UI designed for fast setup

  • Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, and other page builders

  • Multilingual & Translation Ready

Languages

This plugin is fully translation-ready and supports localization via translate.wordpress.org.

Bundled plugin-interface translations include:
* English (default)
* French
* Danish

The customer-facing calendar can follow the website language or use one of 67 explicit language and regional choices. This localizes month names, weekdays, selected-date summaries, and confirmation dates without loading a separate Flatpickr language file for every choice.

You can help translate this plugin into your language at:
https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/creavi-booking-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it via the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Activate it through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Create a new Service post and configure your booking options.
  4. Place the generated shortcode anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
Can I display multiple booking buttons on one page?

Yes! Each service has its own shortcode and popup — ideal for showcasing different services.

Does it support timezone differences?

Yes. Choose to display time slots in the visitor’s local timezone or lock them to the admin’s.

Can I customize the emails sent after booking?

Absolutely. You can fully customize both admin and user email templates using tags like {name}, {service}, {date}, and more.

Is Google Calendar synchronization included for free?

Yes. You can automatically add bookings to Google Calendar and block time slots that are already busy in the connected calendar.

Does Creavi support Outlook Calendar?

Yes. Each service can connect to Outlook Calendar, automatically create booking events, and block busy Outlook time slots.

Are Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar connections free?

Yes. Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar connections are included in the free plugin, with no separate Creavi calendar-sync subscription.

Are the number of services or bookings limited?

No. Creavi does not impose service or booking limits. The practical capacity depends on your WordPress site and hosting resources.

Are appointment reminder emails included for free?

Yes. Customer and admin reminders are included. You can choose how far in advance they are sent and set a specific delivery time for day-before reminders.

Can customer and admin reminders use different schedules?

Yes. Customer and admin reminders can be enabled independently and can use different reminder timings and email templates.

What happens if WordPress Cron runs late?

Creavi checks for overdue reminders and sends them on the next available cron run before the appointment. For delivery close to an exact time on a quiet website, configure your server to call wp-cron.php regularly.

Can reminders include the video meeting link?

Yes. Reminder templates support video link tags. Customers receive their personalized customer link, while admin reminders use the host-specific link.

What meeting types can I offer?

You can offer in-person appointments, phone calls, custom online meeting links, or secure video meetings generated by Creavi.

Can Google or Outlook events block unavailable booking times?

Yes. When calendar availability synchronization is enabled, busy events from the connected Google or Outlook calendar are removed from the available frontend time slots.

How does the buffer between appointments work?

Set an optional 5 to 60 minute buffer for each service. Creavi adds the buffer after every appointment when calculating available time slots and conflicts with local, Google Calendar, and Outlook Calendar events. The admin availability grid updates immediately when the duration or buffer changes.

Can Creavi automatically clean up old booking records?

Yes. In All Bookings, enable automatic cleanup and choose a preset retention period or a custom number of days. Eligible completed bookings can be moved to Trash or deleted permanently. Cleanup affects local WordPress booking records only; it does not delete Google or Outlook Calendar events.

Can I export bookings?

Yes. Select bookings in All Bookings and export them to CSV or Excel. The export includes standard booking data and custom fields, and CSV files can be imported directly into Google Sheets.

Can each service use a different calendar language?

Yes. Each service can follow the website language or use one of 67 explicit language and regional choices. Month names, weekdays, selected-date summaries, and confirmation dates follow the selected calendar language.

Does it work with Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes. Use the shortcodes with Elementor or other page builders, or use the included Gutenberg booking blocks and layouts.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Redesigned the service editor into a clean, full-width, fixed-order setup with consistent panels, a loading state, and no draggable WordPress metabox controls.
  • Added a larger desktop calendar preview with subtle edit shortcuts that jump directly to the related title, description, availability, time-slot, and form settings.
  • Reworked inline and popup display settings with clear calendar illustrations, a dedicated popup-button preview, and consistent button styling controls.
  • Added a compact movable save panel for publishing, updating, shortcode copying, and privacy-friendly usage-metrics preferences.
  • Renamed and improved the Service Image workflow, including immediate live-preview updates and clearer unsaved-change feedback.
  • Added 10-minute and 15-minute appointment durations across booking availability, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, emails, and video meetings.
  • Added Phone Number as a configurable default field and added Telephone and Number custom-field types.
  • Made Name, Email, Phone, consent, and custom-field labels and requirements consistent and editable, with {phone} support in email and calendar templates.
  • Added an option to display only the booked start time in the footer summary and confirmation emails.
  • Added selected-booking exports to CSV and Excel, including core booking data and custom form fields, with Google Sheets-ready CSV output.
  • Added per-service calendar localization with the website default plus 67 explicit language and regional choices, localized summaries and confirmation dates, and right-to-left calendar support.
  • Hardened booking creation so unpublished services, invalid dates and times, excluded or out-of-window dates, insufficient notice, local conflicts, and connected-calendar conflicts are rechecked before saving.
  • Corrected Outlook sync status reporting so a skipped sync is not recorded as successful.
  • Improved service-title onboarding, placeholders, tooltips, labels, spacing, alignment, accessibility, and visual consistency throughout the editor.

1.4.10

  • Added HTML-capable visual and code editors for customer/admin confirmation and reminder email bodies, including Add Media support for logos.
  • Added a conservative email HTML sanitizer that supports presentation tables, inline styles, links, and images while removing scripts, forms, embedded media, and other unsafe markup.
  • Added automatic conversion of existing plain-text templates into safe HTML plus a plain-text alternative for clients that cannot display HTML.
  • Improved paragraph rendering with explicit block layout, line height, spacing, and Outlook margin fallbacks so editor rows remain separate in delivered emails.
  • Added simple, neutral default layouts for customer confirmations, admin notifications, and customer/admin reminders.
  • Added a “Use default template” button when a service already has a custom body, without replacing saved content automatically.
  • Improved automatically appended video meeting links so HTML emails receive a separate, clickable link row.
  • Refined the default emails into clean, left-aligned confirmation letters with stacked details and no visible table design.
  • Made “Use default template” persist explicitly during service saving so visual-editor synchronization cannot discard the reset.
  • Removed duplicate video-meeting links from the end of default and location-aware emails while retaining a fallback for custom bodies that omit all meeting details.
  • Rebuilt default email sections with invisible presentation rows so Gmail and Outlook cannot collapse headings, details, actions, and footer copy onto one line.
  • Kept services that use a default email body linked to the current default instead of storing a frozen copy.
  • Automatically upgraded untouched older admin booking notifications to the collapse-proof default while preserving customized admin bodies.
  • Made edited paragraphs collapse-proof by wrapping each one in an independent presentation row with structural spacing, while preserving color and highlight formatting.
  • Removed browser console noise and restricted sanitized Google Calendar diagnostics to development environments with WP_DEBUG enabled.

1.4.9

  • Added optional automatic cleanup of completed booking records with preset or custom retention periods.
  • Added Trash and permanent-delete cleanup methods, a manual cleanup action, daily batched cleanup, and a clear eligible-booking count.
  • Added an optional per-service 5–60 minute buffer between appointments, including local, Google Calendar, and Outlook availability checks.

1.4.8

  • Fixed popup scroll locking so closing a booking popup no longer jumps the page position.
  • Improved time slot loading feedback with a minimal service-color loading line for popup and inline booking layouts.
  • Improved time slot loading speed by removing a frontend delay, aborting stale slot requests, fetching only the selected day from Google Calendar busy checks, and briefly caching remote busy-calendar responses.
  • Improved Google and Outlook busy-slot checks so slow remote calendar responses cannot block frontend availability loading for as long.
  • Fixed a double-click issue where rapidly clicking Next could accidentally trigger the final booking action.
  • Removed the “Book another appointment” button from the thank-you screen in popup and inline booking layouts.
  • Fixed repeat bookings without a page refresh by resetting stale success-button state and reloading the selected date’s available slots when the popup is opened again.

1.4.7

  • Added an optional GDPR/cookies consent checkbox for booking forms, including customizable label text, privacy policy URL, and required/optional behavior.
  • Added frontend and backend validation for required consent so bookings cannot bypass the checkbox when it is marked required.
  • Improved consent handling so optional consent can still record whether the customer accepted or did not accept the policy.
  • Improved secure video reminder links so customer reminders use the customer link and admin reminders use the host-specific link.
  • Improved recovery for older secure video bookings by rebuilding and storing the admin meeting link from saved participant tokens when needed.
  • Added a black theme option that applies the full inline calendar or booking popup.

1.4.6

  • Added a specific send-time setting for day-before customer and admin reminders.
  • Improved reminder reliability so delayed WP-Cron runs can recover and send overdue reminders before the appointment.
  • Added conditional reminder settings that only show the day-before send time when “1 day before” is selected.
  • Fixed personalized secure video links so customers receive the customer link and hosts receive the host link in reminders.
  • Fixed automatic Google and Outlook Calendar events to use the host-specific secure video link.
  • Improved secure video link consistency across emails, calendar links, and calendar attachments.

1.4.5

  • Security: Fixed stored XSS in custom booking field labels.
  • Hardened custom booking field validation to safely handle malformed input and previously stored field data.
